text:
Olivia M.: heads-up: customer `QuickShip` onboarding stalled at step 5/9, tokens down ~30% week-over-week, renewal in 16 days. thinking a quick intercept: auto-probes + micro fixes, then a simple downgrade opt-in if needed. any objections?

Ben S.: no objections. propose 48h rescue: Tier A auto-fixes (cache TTL + webhook backoff), Tier B 20-min enablement + 100-shot eval, Tier C opt-in soft-downgrade with 20% credit.

Harper L.: I can run the probes and push non-disruptive cache change to staging. also draft a short outreach line.

Olivia M.: outreach draft: "Hi QuickShip  we saw onboarding pause. We rolled a small perf tweak that often resolves timeouts. Can we do a 20-min sync or send async notes?"

InfraBot: recent logs uploaded: https://support.internal/quickship/459 (3 webhook timeouts, 1 504).

Ben S.: Tier A (0-48h):
- route cache TTL 12s -> 60s
- enable prefix_kv for onboarding route
- set webhook retry cap=3 with jitter
- enable 5% canary for 4h
Apply changes one at a time and monitor p95 + error rate.

Harper L.: pushed cache change to staging; KV hit up from 40% -> 72% and p95 improved ~450ms. starting 5% canary now.

Olivia M.: will send outreach and calendar invite. target: if Tier A restores metrics within 72h, close. else Tier B next.

Ben S.: Tier B (3-7d): 20-min enablement, prompt calibration, run 100-shot eval vs quantized candidate (compare semantic sim + hallucination). only recommend model switch after review.

Harper L.: will prepare rollback snippet for flags and upload a short eval template.

Olivia M.: outcome: restore onboarding flow to within 10% of baseline or secure soft-downgrade opt-in with credit + rollback. tagging play as "onboarding-intercept: soft-downgrade". follow-up scheduled in 48h. :white_check_mark:
